name: Dragon Harbinger (Dragon Disciple Archetype)
body:
A dragon harbinger forfeits spellcasting to become as lethal as a dragon in melee combat.

Requirements

To qualify to become a dragon harbinger, a character must fulfill all the following criteria.

Race: Any non—dragon.
Base Attack Bonus: +5.
Languages: Draconic.
Special: Ability to make two claws attacks as a bloodline power.

This alters requirements.

Class Skills: A dragon harbinger adds Climb (Str) to his class skills in place of Spellcraft (Int). This alters class skills.

Dragon Warrior (Ex)

A dragon harbinger adds +1 to his base attack bonus at every level.

This replaces the dragon disciple’s spellcasting ability.
